title: Map-Reduce Chains
summary: This module provides the MapReduceChain, a powerful tool for processing large text documents by splitting them into smaller chunks, applying a language model to each chunk (map step), and then combining the results into a concise final output (reduce step).

nodes.label: Map-Reduce Chain
nodes.title: Orchestrates Map-Reduce Process
nodes.description: The main component that orchestrates the entire map-reduce workflow, managing text splitting and the combination of mapped and reduced results.

nodes.label: Large Input Text
nodes.title: Source Document for Processing
nodes.description: The extensive text document or collection of documents that needs to be processed and summarized or analyzed by the chain.

nodes.label: Split Text into Chunks
nodes.title: Document Chunking Utility
nodes.description: A utility that breaks down the large input text into smaller, manageable document chunks, making them suitable for individual processing by an LLM.

nodes.label: Process Document Chunks (Map)
nodes.title: LLM for Map & Combine Steps
nodes.description: An LLM-powered chain responsible for processing individual document chunks during the 'map' phase and also for combining results during the 'reduce' phase.

nodes.label: Combine Mapped Results (Stuff)
nodes.title: Stuffing for Reduction
nodes.description: A chain that gathers and 'stuffs' multiple mapped document results into a single context, preparing them for a final LLM call during the reduction phase.

nodes.label: Iteratively Reduce Documents
nodes.title: Reduction Orchestration
nodes.description: Manages the iterative reduction of document chunks, using a combining chain (like StuffDocumentsChain) to progressively consolidate information until a single result remains.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Map & Reduce
nodes.title: Overall Map-Reduce Orchestrator
nodes.description: The core orchestrator that coordinates the entire map and reduce process, handling the flow from individual chunk processing to final result aggregation.

nodes.label: Language Model (LLM)
nodes.title: Generative AI Model
nodes.description: The underlying large language model used for both mapping individual document chunks and for the final combination/reduction steps.

nodes.label: LLM Prompt Template
nodes.title: Instruction Template for LLM
nodes.description: The template defining the instructions and context provided to the Language Model for processing document chunks and combining results.

nodes.label: Final Processed Output
nodes.title: Aggregated and Summarized Result
nodes.description: The consolidated and processed output generated by the map-reduce chain after all mapping and reduction steps are complete, representing the final answer or summary.

groups.label: Surface Components
groups.title: User-Facing Interface
groups.description: Components that serve as the primary interface for users to interact with the module's functionality.

groups.label: Orchestration Components
groups.title: Workflow Management
groups.description: Components responsible for managing the flow of data and control between different processing steps, coordinating the map and reduce operations.

groups.label: Generative Components
groups.title: Text Generation & Processing
groups.description: Components that utilize large language models to generate or transform text based on given prompts and inputs.

groups.label: Analytical Components
groups.title: Data Transformation & Analysis
groups.description: Components that perform operations like splitting, parsing, or combining data to prepare it for or process it from generative models.

groups.label: Data Input/Output
groups.title: External Data Flow
groups.description: Represents the entry and exit points for data interacting with the module.
